title: Role of PET/CT in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (Review)

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma (DLBCL) is the most common subtype of non-Hodgkin lymphoma, and its diagnosis and management are moving steadily toward personalization and precision.

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】During therapy, an interim ΔSUVmax reduction of ≤66% indicates high-risk patients, while a negative interim Deauville score (1-3) and a negative end-of-treatment PET/CT both predict favorable long-term survival.
